edges.rationale: The JD explicitly states working with Golang on Azure cloud projects.
Ansible is a tool used for implementing Infrastructure as Code practices.
The JD mentions working with Docker, which supports deployment within AWS cloud environments.
The JD mentions using Splunk to monitor Azure cloud systems.
Prometheus is commonly used for monitoring Azure cloud applications.
GitLab CI is built on top of Git and used for version control.
The JD specifically mentions working with AWS and Azure together.
Jira is a tool used within Agile methodologies for issue tracking and collaboration.
Confluence supports collaboration within Agile teams.
Debian is a Linux distribution often used in Azure cloud environments.
Bash is used as a scripting language within Ansible playbooks.
An engineering degree enables a deeper understanding of system design and software development principles, which are relevant to Golang.
Teamwork skills complement agile methodologies, which rely on collaborative teams.
